types.name: ExpandableTextProps
types.doc: Long text clamped to a few lines with a soft fade over the last one. Read more opens it to its full height with a calm ease out, and Show less closes it again, bringing the start of the text back into view when it had scrolled away. The toggle only appears when the text really overflows its lines, and stays correct as the width or font changes.

members.name: children
members.doc: The text. Plain strings, paragraphs, and inline links all work; the whole text stays available to screen readers while clamped.

members.name: lines
members.doc: How many lines show while collapsed.
